thread:
marta_partnerships: Heads-up: vendor PO from CortexEdge (APAC) is failing marketplace ingestion due to billing entity mismatch. Customer wants a go-live this week. Can we triage? :alarm_clock:

jen_finance: Please paste PO# and the rejection text. Finance needs to know whether we can accept a manual invoice as fallback.

marketplace-bot: ingestion_failure: code=vendor_entity_mismatch; received="CortexEdge Global Ltd"; expected="CortexEdge APAC Holdings Pty Ltd"

marta_partnerships: PO# 2026-CE-9912. Screenshot attached to ticket. Customer says procurement will only sign the current PO form.

omar_ops: Marketplace enforces exact alias registry matching. We can create a temporary alias mapping if we have a signed vendor alias confirmation or an authorized email from vendor payments. Without that webhook rejects automatically.

kailash_legal: I can draft a one-paragraph "billing alias confirmation" amendment that doesn't touch price or IP. Vendor counsel usually signs quickly for narrow language. I'll draft and send to CortexEdge counsel.

tom_sales: Timeline is tight. If legal can send amendment today, sales will push procurement. Otherwise we may need manual invoice approval from finance for this one-off. Customer is sensitive to delays.

jen_finance: Manual invoice is doable but requires revenue ops tagging and will delay automated recognition. Prefer to get the marketplace PO in place. If legal posts the signed amendment to the MP ticket, finance can update the alias immediately and retry ingestion.

omar_ops: Operationally we can also pre-stage the alias if you give exact alias string and tax id. Provide: PO id, alias, tax_id, contact_email. We'll open a temporary exception to allow ingestion for only this PO while we wait for signed doc.

marta_partnerships: I'll coordinate vendor to sign. Kailash, can you post template in the ticket? Jen, please standby for the signed doc. Tom will inform customer of plan.

marketplace-bot: ticket created MP-4620 "CortexEdge APAC alias pre-stage for PO 2026-CE-9912" assigned to omar_ops.

kailash_legal: Draft uploaded to MP-4620. It's intentionally narrow and vendor-friendly. DMed vendor legal contact.

jen_finance: Copy me on MP-4620 when signed. I'll prepare the accounting entry steps if we need manual invoice fallback.

tom_sales: I'll update the customer and set expectation: aiming to keep marketplace flow; will escalate if counsel delays. :thumbsup:

marta_partnerships: Thanks team. Ping here once signed or if the vendor asks for language tweaks.
